query: When did World War II end?
generated_response: World War II ended on September 2, 1945, when the atomic bombs dropped by the United States and the Soviet Union on Hiroshima and Nagasaki respectively resulted in the complete destruction of those cities. The war was officially concluded on September 26 with the surrender of Nazi Germany and Italy to the Allied forces.
